description: This file defines the SuiteEditorMozaik class, which implements the SuiteEditorInterface for the Mozaik editor within the SuiteCRM system. It includes setup and rendering methods, requiring external dependencies such as SuiteMozaik and Sugar_Smarty, and provides HTML generation for the editor interface.

classes.name: SuiteEditorMozaik
classes.description: Implements the SuiteEditorInterface for the Mozaik editor, providing setup and HTML rendering functionalities.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the suite editor with optional settings and loads the SuiteMozaik dependency.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the editor by assigning variables to Smarty template engine and fetching the rendered template.
